description:
The map displays several clusters of Natura 2000 (N2K) sites and their surrounding 2 km buffer zones, likely located within France based on the "FR" prefix in the site identifiers. Individual Natura 2000 site boundaries are outlined in blue, while areas where these boundaries have undergone minor adaptations, imprecision corrections, or omission error fixes are highlighted with a red outline. A light grey shaded area encompasses each N2K site, representing a 2 km buffer around the site boundary.

Specific Natura 2000 sites identified by their codes include:
*   FR8212005, FR8202002, FR8201773 in the top left cluster.
*   FR8201781 in the central-left and lower-left clusters.
*   FR8212028 and FR8202003 associated with the large central landmass.
*   FR8201777 in the top-right and lower-right clusters.

The map illustrates the spatial extent of the Natura 2000 Area of Interest (N2K Aol), including buffered zones and adapted site geometries during a production phase, as described in the accompanying text. No scale bar, compass, or explicit legend is visible within the image.
